liebermann.description_de: Holinshed's Chronicle of England (Lond. 1577), Description of England von W. H[arrison]
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Holinshed’s Chronicles (London, 1577): William Harrison’s Description of England
liebermann.notes: Harrison's Description of England prefixed to Holinshed's Chronicle (1577); f. 89v Ps Cn for. From Ho derive Ho 2 (the 1587 edition), Additional 6668 and Harley 785, 814. The Description also has Iud Dei XVI in English translation, perhaps from Ld and Co.
